notes: Read SKILL.md, SPEC.md and references/archive-criteria.md in full. Triages unresolved issues in the Sentry `javascript` project via the Sentry MCP server: classifies each issue against a noise taxonomy, shows a plan table, and archives approved issues with status=ignored / ignoreMode=untilEscalating and a stated reason.

Medium because it changes live state in a Sentry organization through an authenticated MCP server (update_issue). Acceptable: SKILL.md:15-21 hard-limits it to archive-only, untilEscalating, unresolved issues, one project, and requires explicit user approval of a displayed plan before any update_issue call (SKILL.md:20, 97-115); it never resolves, assigns or deletes.

Practically scoped to Sentry's own organization (organizationSlug='sentry', project 'javascript'; SKILL.md:15, 46, 50) and requires the Sentry MCP at mcp.sentry.dev to be authenticated (SKILL.md:25-26); other users would need to adapt it.
